title: Joint Domain-Class Modeling for Federated Learning Under Feature Skew
abstract: arXiv:2609.22932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without centralizing private data, but performance often degrades under feature skew: clients share labels while the conditional input distributions $p_i(x\!\mid\!y)$ vary due to latent, client-specific appearance factors. We propose Joint Domain-Class Federated Learning (JDFL), a lightweight, optimizer-agnostic extension that makes this latent domain variation usable without sharing raw data. JDFL first infers domain clusters called pseudo-domains from brief local update signals. It then expands the classifier head to output $M\times C$, joint (domain-class) logits. This allows the model to represent domain-conditioned appearance while keeping a shared backbone. translated_title: 面向特征偏斜联邦学习的联合域-类建模
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）能够在无需集中私有数据的情况下进行协作模型训练，但在特征偏斜的情况下性能往往会下降：客户端共享相同的标签，而条件输入分布 $p_i(x\mid y)$ 则由于潜在的、客户端特定的外观因素而各不相同。我们提出了联合域-类联邦学习，这是一种轻量级、与优化器无关的扩展方法，能够在不共享原始数据的前提下利用这种潜在的域变化。JDFL 首先从简短的本地更新信号中推断出称为“伪域”的域聚类。然后，它将分类器头扩展为输出 $M\times C$ 维的联合（域-类）logits。这使得模型在保持共享骨干网络的同时，能够表示域条件化的外观特征。为了训练扩展后的分类器头，我们基于简单的直觉引入了两种互补的监督策略：一种是相似性感知的软标签方法，它在相近的推断域之间传递证据，同时允许域……
tldr: 提出JDFL方法，通过从本地更新信号推断伪域并扩展分类器头输出联合域-类logits，在不共享原始数据的情况下解决联邦学习中的特征偏斜问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes JDFL, which infers pseudo-domains from brief local update signals and expands the classifier head to output joint domain-class logits, addressing feature skew in federated learning without sharing raw data.
